title: Open extension and invertibility of its specified tensor transpose
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, Base b, an open immersion j:U to T, and Geometry g for j as in [def-sp-tower-shriek-data]. There exists Open o for this specific g, with its ordinary evaluation, adjunction-unit and adjunction-counit equations and termwise derived adjunction. For all system-derived objects K on U and L on T, the o.extension left-adjunction transpose of (unit_K tensor identity) followed by the inverse of g.tensorPullback at (o.extension K,L) is invertible. No geometric coordinates for other scheme maps, inverse-image composition or Base is constructed.

proof.text: Construct extension by zero on the actual ringed vertical sequence site by direct sums over the open factorizations and sheafification. The quotient transitions act on those same summands. Its summand Hom correspondence gives the adjunction to the supplied g.pull, fixed on open sections; evaluation gives precisely the normalized finite adjunction and both unit and counit equations. Exactness localizes the functor, unit and counit termwise to the required Open record.

Apply the system-site open tensor support argument of openTensorNormalization. On the open part the specified adjunction unit and inverse tensor-pullback comparison identify the displayed transpose with the identity; on the complementary closed part both sides vanish. Open and closed restriction jointly detect isomorphisms. The signed K-flat representative normalization identifies the arrow with the displayed g.tensorPullback transpose, so it is this actual arrow that is invertible, without detecting equality by derived evaluations. Empty and identity opens and arbitrary nonflat coefficient transitions are covered.

theorem strictOpenTensorCoordinates (b : Base l E)
    {U T : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j] (g : Geometry l E b j) :
    ∃ o : Open l E b j g, ∀ (K : D l E U) (L : D l E T),
      IsIso ((o.derivedAdjunction.homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((tensor l E b U).map (Prod.mkHom (o.derivedAdjunction.unit.app K) (𝟙 _)) ≫
          g.tensorPullback.inv.app ((openD l E b o).obj K, L)))
